faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q_steering: Why doesn't my steering wheel move in the Controls tab?
faq.a_steering: Make sure your device is detected in Settings > Controls. Sometimes restarting QARL or unplugging/replugging the wheel is enough. Also check the console (F12) to see if the device is listed.
faq.q_files: Where are my race files generated?
faq.a_files: The 'race.ini' file and weather plans are generated in 'Documents/Assetto Corsa/cfg'.
faq.q_pure: How does Pure work in QARL?
faq.a_pure: QARL reads your existing Pure plans or creates new ones in 'extension/config-ext/PurePlanner'. A temporary file is injected if necessary so the game loads the correct weather, then it is cleaned up on exit.
faq.q_steam: Why is my Steam ID important?
faq.a_steam: It allows the game to identify you correctly during multiplayer sessions. Without it, online servers will refuse the connection.
faq.a_csp: CSP is a major extension for Assetto Corsa. It drastically improves graphics, adds advanced weather effects, improves physics, and allows for extensive visual customization.
faq.a_csp_qarl: QARL's CSP tab allows you to modify your configuration files (like graphics settings or FSR/DLSS modules) safely. QARL always creates a backup (.bak) before modifying anything. You can also save and load your own presets.

csp.title: Custom Shaders Patch — Modules
csp.file_name_error:
The selected file must be named exactly "{name}".
You chose: "{chosen}".

Please try again.
csp.confirm_module_reset_all: Reset this ENTIRE module to factory defaults?

option_labels.Desktop scale (for setups with multiple: Desktop scale (for setups with multiple monitors with different pixel densities)
option_labels.Fixes depth fighting artifacts, improves: Fixes depth fighting artifacts, improves LODs, fixes MSAA, optionally replaces FXAA by CMAA, adds post-processing refraction and more.
option_labels.Adds procedurally generated grass. Might: Adds procedurally generated grass. Might be pretty expensive, especially with extra density enabled.
option_labels.Skip loading of old grass meshes (might: Skip loading of old grass meshes (might slightly increase loading speed and decrease RAM and VRAM consumption)
option_labels.Use smoother blending with MSAA (negativ: Use smoother blending with MSAA (negatively affects performance)
option_labels.CARS_WITH_LIGHTS: Cars casting lights (to save FPS, you can have only limited number of cars casting light)
option_labels.DISABLE_MIRRORING: (collapse all headlights and brakelights by default)
option_labels.DISABLE_MIRRORING_FIRSTPERSON: Disable mirroring in first person view (turn both headlights into one while driving in first person view)
option_labels.CARS_SHADOWS: Cars with shadows (with zero, selected car wouldn’t cast shadows as well)
option_labels.SPECTATING_CARS_SHADOWS: Cars with shadows in replay (or without a focused car, like with free or track camera)
option_labels.CARS_IN_TRACK_SHADOWS: Include car shadows in track lights’ shadows (if disabled, forces all shadows to operate in static mode)
option_labels.DETAILED_SHADOWS_FROM_CARS_NEARBY: Detailed car shadows (number of closest cars casting detailed shadows instead of using a single call with LOD D or collider mesh)
option_labels.SOFT_PARTICLES: Soft particles (reduces clipping by using depth buffer to blend particles nicely)
option_labels.REWORKED_HEAT_SHIMMER: Updated heat shimmer (adds more sources and more conditions for heat shimmer, requires restart)
option_labels.NEW_HEATING: New heating calculation (to ensure smoke works the same for all cars in the session, CSP estimates tyre temperature using the data available for all)
option_labels.USE_DOWNSCALING: Render in half resolution when possible
option_labels.QUANTITY_SCALE: Quantity limit (limits amount of particles next to each other)
option_labels.SIMPLIFIED_SHADING: Simplified shading (can help with FPS for some low-end GPUs)
option_labels.FILL_SCREEN: Cover view in smoke when camera is deep in it
option_labels.RESET_WITH_NEW_SESSION: Reset with new session in multi-session race
